edition.name: Bohnanza
edition.notes: Current AMIGO product page separates the 104-card base game from a 50-card expansion and lists 3-7 players. The linked rules are Rule Bohnanza [ZA RULES 8.21]. The 25th Anniversary Edition is treated as a distinct edition.
